scope: new-run subprocess GPU-device energy, includes idle; excludes pip/upload and unobserved intervals; not whole-system energy
nested_containers: extension_queue/candidate_costs use measured children; concurrent language children are excluded and their observed whole-device group interval is counted once
training_only_times: complete.json training_seconds is each job elapsed training time; concurrent language times are shared-device times, not isolated costs; use group wall time for rental and throughput
multiple_devices: Independent jobs have per-physical-device power records. Sum of job seconds is device-work, not rental elapsed time when GPUs overlap. Prior and new server identities are recorded in environment/migration_verified.json.

language_execution_override.training_times_scope: per-job elapsed time under shared GPU allocation, not isolated method cost
language_execution_override.reason: User requested high GPU utilization; single-process language training was CPU launch limited
